name: dsh-ccswitch
description: Import CCSwitch's skills (~/.cc-switch/skills), MCP servers, AND providers/models (~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db) into DeepSeek Harness in one plugin: skills show up in the '/' reference menu, MCP servers are mounted as mcp__<server>__<tool> tools, and models become ccswitch-* llm-pi-ai routes carrying CCSwitch's context-window and max-output settings — without modifying DSH itself.
